name: btr-swap-monorepo
author: BTR Supply <contact@btr.supply>
description: Generic Bridge+Swap aggregator for compatible EVMs

scripts.lint: bun run prettier:check && bun run eslint:check
scripts.lint:fix: bun run prettier:fix && bun run eslint:fix
scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:cli
scripts.clean: bun run clean:core && bun run clean:cli
scripts.typecheck: bun run build:core && bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:cli
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:integration
scripts.setup: bun install && bun run build && bun run install:cli
scripts.pre-commit: bun run prettier:fix && bun run eslint:fix && bun run eslint:check && bun run clean && bun run build && bun run test:unit
scripts.publish:patch: bun run pre-commit && bun run version:bump:patch && npm publish --workspaces
scripts.publish:minor: bun run pre-commit && bun run version:bump:minor && npm publish --workspaces
scripts.publish:major: bun run pre-commit && bun run version:bump:major && npm publish --workspaces
